docs.title: Acme widget sales climb in 2026
docs.text: Acme widget sales rose in 2026. Dealer inventories tightened through the spring as orders outpaced production for the first time in three years. The flagship W-500 model accounted for nearly half of all Acme widget units sold this year.

docs.title: Independent audit questions Acme widget growth
docs.text: Acme widget sales did not rise in 2026. The independent auditors reviewed shipment records from all seven regional Acme distribution centers. Retail partners described flat widget sell-through despite heavier promotional spending.
